episodes.title: Dear you who waits by the door
episodes.summary: An emotional letter addressing the habit of shrinking to keep the peace, pivoting toward the realization that solitude is a safe space and self-acceptance requires no permission.

episodes.title: Quiet signs of deep respect
episodes.summary: Explores four everyday signs of genuine respect and safety in a relationship, anchored by the quotable line that real respect is the quiet safety of being fully yourself.

episodes.arc_title: integrity and character when nobody is watching
episodes.title: Quiet Integrity
episodes.summary: An emotional letter celebrating personal integrity and doing the right thing when unobserved. Hook: Dear you, who fixes the crooked painting in an empty hallway just so it looks right.
episodes.theme: integrity and character when nobody is watching

episodes.title: Healing After Heartbreak
episodes.summary: An exploration of healing after heartbreak, addressing the non-linear nature of grief and recovery. Hook: You still catch yourself reaching for a phone that hasn't buzzed in months.

episodes.title: Quiet Loyalty in Friendship
episodes.summary: An emotional letter addressing the quiet, loyal friend who notices everything and worries their care goes unseen. The hook centers on keeping old birthday cards, leading to the core truth that true friendship stays when the room goes dark.
